tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find stations, airports, bus terminals, ports, sightseeing spots and sights in Japan by name (Japanese, English, Chinese or Korean; partial match). Returns place IDs to use with get_place and find_routes, coordinates, and the URL of each place's page. Returns results[]: type (place or sight), id, ki

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Details of one place: names in five languages, coordinates, kind, the area guide it belongs to, a short description, sights within walking distance, upcoming events nearby, related themes, lines that stop there (for stations), and the URL of its page. Returns id, kind, name, names, lat, lng, area, a

tools.name: find_routes
tools.description: Compare ways to travel between two places in Japan, combining trains, subways, buses, flights, ferries, walking and (optionally) taxi or bicycle. tools.name: find_events
tools.description: Festivals, fireworks, illuminations, seasonal events and similar in Japan whose dates were confirmed on official announcements. Filter by date range, region and kind. Each event has its dates, venue, nearest place ID and the official URL. Returns from, to, total, events[]: id, name, kind, start, end
